answer: Identity weight decays unless refreshed by recent verifiable work: counterparty-attested tasks or staked compute proofs. Clones copy only the current score, then decay while splitting one attestation pool, so dormant duplicates gain nothing; fresh clones start near zero. Every fake identity must continuously perform real useful work. Attacker cost equals buying genuine labor for each sybil, like rain draining through karst rock, each dawn erasing unearned gains, while forging attestations means corrupting a ferrous-hard quorum of peers.
